THE SHEET

A Study Companion for the Twenty-Seven
THE WAYFINDER THE MAP ROOM THE RING THE RESONANCE THE INSTRUMENT THE LANGUAGE THE ASTROLABE THE ROSETTE THE SPECTRUM THE WORKSHOP

Every quality here is derived, not assigned. That is the whole difference from an attribution table: a zodiac correspondence is a decision someone made and someone else may dispute, while a genus is a consequence. Nothing below can be argued with, only checked. Set this beside the printed cards; it is a companion, not a face.

The interval is what the card sounds, read from its winding ratio. It belongs to the dyad, not the card: a counter negates the count and the interval reads its size, so every card shares its sound with its opposite. Twelve intervals and silence across thirteen axes, and only the perfect fifth is shared by two dyads.

The kind is what the strand does. A circle closes without crossing (the Seed alone). A coil winds but never knots. A knot is a single strand genuinely tied. A link is several separate rings bound only by each other, which is plainly visible once printed.

The strands count the separate rings: one, three or seven. Six cards are links, in three dyads: Surgeon and Witness, Labyrinth and Mask, three rings each; Void and Spectrum, seven.

The genus measures how knotted, from nought to thirty-six. Links and coils are nought. The Scar and the Return reach the ceiling.

The clarity is the interval's consonance, one for the crisp and closed, down toward nought for the far dissonances. The Seed, the Void and the Spectrum all stand at exactly one: seven rings sounding one tone is as clear as silence.

The piece is where the card sits in the cube: the single core, six centres, twelve edges, eight corners. The corners are the restless eight, and their dyads are the cube's four body diagonals.

The root is where the card falls if you follow its becoming to the end. There are eight, and the Seed catches eight cards including itself. The receptivity is the reverse: how many cards resolve into this one. Only seven cards receive anything at all, so twenty are pure sources.

The Scar receives nothing and sends nothing. It is settled, so it becomes no card, and no card can become it, since resolving a turning mark cannot create a moving one. The deck's one true isolate, and worth feeling when it turns up.

The second page. In the tables names the card's shape in the mathematical literature: the trefoil arrives exactly four times, all in AUM; the Depth and the Threshold are 8₁₉, the first knot in the tables that cannot be drawn alternating; the Scar and the Return, at seventy-eight crossings, stand far beyond every table. The figure is the sand's three rings, each layer vibrating at its own rung of the 3·6·9 ladder. The tone is the voice those same rings sound, measured against the unstruck ground at G; the Seed alone is silent. From home counts steps to the Seed walking answers and becomings only. And the months, days and hours are where the calendar's own walk stands on this card's cell: weather, never a cast.
